messages.text: Can we just use Cursor. ChatGPT in the browser is killing me. I need it in the editor. I'll pay on my card if Legal is going to sit on this.
+1 we already let people use Copilot on personal github. this is the same thing right
It is not the same thing. Stop. No personal cards, no personal github. I need to see their terms before anyone pastes customer data into a prompt.
Fine. Company login. Can I at least start with my Gmail so I can try it this week.
No. Company SSO only. Named owner. Internal employees. Prompt logs Legal can actually read. That bar does not move because you are blocked this sprint.

From their terms (Anysphere ToS excerpt): We may use Customer Content to operate, maintain, and improve the Services, including to train and improve our models, unless you have an executed opt-out addendum. File: cursor-tos-excerpt.pdf
That is exactly why. They train unless we have paper. I also want written proof they do not keep our code after the session. Do not paste customer PII into prompts in the meantime.
GDPR Art. 28 — if they process personal data for us they are a processor. We need a signed DPA with this vendor, not a screenshot of a marketing page. I am not signing on a terms paste.
Emailed their sales. They said the DPA is on the trust site, click accept. That is not how we do this. Chasing a countersigned copy.
Any news. It has been two weeks. People are using it anyway on personal laptops which is worse.
Vendor legal still reviewing our annex. I sent the no-training-on-code language again. I do not have a file number yet.
Logs: they offered 30 days. We need 6 months and Legal must be able to read them. Do not accept 30 days to close this faster.
This is a month. Can someone just tell me if this is dead.
Not dead. Still not signing until Tomas has a countersigned DPA and the training opt-out is in the annex, not in a Slack screenshot.

Anysphere DPA countersigned (file PROC-DPA-CURSOR-2026-05). Training opt-out is in the DPA annex: they do not train on customer code and do not retain prompts after the session. SSO via our IdP is on.

Legal signs Cursor for Engineering, owner Lena Hofmann, internal IDE use only. Conditions: no customer PII in prompts; company SSO; 6-month prompt audit; Anysphere DPA on file; no-training-on-code annex. This DPA does not cover any other vendor. Recording the signed record in Greenlit so we do not redo this month in the next thread.
